summary: BotHealthBar.Setup picked its stun source with GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent>(). On Armored and Spiked dog variants that found a runtime EntityProxy that ArmorEntity/JunkDogSpikes put on PhysicsRig/RibCage, and a proxy's stunDamage is always 0. The stun source is now GameEntity.GetEntity(gameObject), which skips proxies. In SP Quick Rampage I spawned Junkdog base/Bloodhound/Spiked/Armored/Turbo and Jungledog base/Spiked/Armored-Left and added 60% stun to each. Every bar's stun source was the root JunkDogEntity, and the bar value matched the entity's stunDamage on all of them. Isolated screenshots show each stun strip partly filled.
instructions:
There is a bug affecting the stun mechanic for certain singleplayer enemy variants: their stun bar UI does not visibly change/fill as they take hits, yet after a number of hits the enemy does actually become stunned. This means the stun bar display is desynced from the underlying stun accumulation logic for these specific enemies.

Affected enemies (singleplayer only):
- All "junkdog" enemy variants EXCEPT the base Junkdog and the Bloodhound Junkdog (those two work correctly)
- All "jungledog" enemy variants EXCEPT the normal/base Jungledog (that one works correctly)

So the bug is specific to variant/subtype enemies within these two enemy families, while the base versions of each family work fine. Find where stun accumulation and stun-bar UI update are implemented for these enemy types, and determine why the variants are not updating their stun bar visual even though stun is being tracked/applied internally (likely something variant-specific overriding or failing to call the stun bar update, or the variants referencing/initializing the stun bar incorrectly compared to the base enemies).

Fix it so that for every affected junkdog and jungledog variant, the stun bar visibly fills/updates in sync with the actual stun accumulation that leads to the enemy becoming stunned, matching the correct behavior already seen in the base Junkdog, Bloodhound Junkdog, and base Jungledog.

Do not rely on any conversation/chat history or prior agent notes about this issue — investigate purely from the current state of the codebase.
verified: Stun bar source resolves to the root JunkDogEntity, not the EntityProxy, on Junkdog Armored, Junkdog Spiked, Jungledog Spiked and Jungledog Armored-Left
